title: Captive Singhs Turn Humiliation into Testimony

blocks.text: As the prisoners are paraded, the Sikhs continue singing and praying for the destruction of the oppressive Turks and for the flourishing of the Khalsa.
Onlookers rage and mock them, but the captives answer with fearless confidence, insisting that death and combat have always been part of Singh identity.
The page turns public humiliation into public testimony.
